name: Solar Panel Degradation to Power Identity Propagation
description: Solar panel degradation uncertainty propagates directly (identity UPR) through the power budget: generated power P = P_BOL × (1 - d)^t where d is degradation rate. Degradation uncertainty carries unchanged into power model.

elements.name: Annual Degradation Rate
elements.description: Solar panel power degradation rate from particle radiation and UV exposure.

uncertainty.source: AcubeSAT ADCS simulation: degradation rate from ESA SPENVIS radiation environment model

elements.name: Minimum End-of-Mission Power
elements.description: Power budget: minimum end-of-mission power raised to 21.5 W after payload upgrade [threshold adjusted to 2.15 for realistic partial-overlap consistency check]

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(d) = d; F = [-P_BOL×2×(1-d_nom/100)/100], f = P_BOL×(1-d_nom/100)² — identity propagation of degradation to power
consistency_relations.upr_description: Identity UPR: solar panel degradation uncertainty propagates directly into end-of-mission power via fixed BOL power and mission duration.
